content.en: Two petitioners point from opposite table edges to two separate interior points of one narrow outlined parcel on the same bank of a mapped river. Both fingertips lie inside that single closed parcel boundary, with clear paper between their hands; the complete boundary and both riverbank endpoints remain visible.
content.ko: 두 청원자가 탁자의 반대쪽에서 지도 속 강의 같은 둑에 있는 하나의 좁은 폐곡선 구획 내부의 서로 다른 두 점을 가리킨다. 두 손가락 끝은 같은 닫힌 구획 경계 안에 놓이고 손 사이의 종이가 분명히 보이며, 구획 경계 전체와 강둑의 두 끝점도 보인다.
content.definition: Held visibility diagnostic: the stated opaque tabletop-map setup combines two connected fingertips inside one closed parcel with an entirely unobscured closed outline. A feasible simultaneous view has not been established; the observed hands cover the outline. Retain this as a conflict example, not a qualified positive realization.

Optional complete authored estate visibility realization, not an historical or causal claim. Preserve every named actor, carrier, part, count, endpoint, state and connection together in the selected view. Respect the independently frozen requester meaning and actual allowed dimensions/properties. Neither a role nor a matching alias grants adoption permission. Whole-source adoption cannot evade source conditions by being called inspiration. partial_is_fail; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS. Research metadata creates no native facts or qualification.
